Source data: Girardi et al. (2000), A&AS, 141, 371, doi:10.1051/aas:2000126. Loader: pyseshat.evolution.parsers.girardi2000.load_girardi2000_vizier_tracks/_isochrones, wired as the default grid via pyseshat.evolution.grids.load_default_evolution_model(). Pipeline: pyseshat.evolution.benchmark_checks.run_system_evolutionary_check (nearest_track -> fit_track independently per component -> fit_common_age jointly), the same code scripts/run_evolutionary_checks.py and scripts/generate_benchmark_plots.py's generate_hrdiagrams() both use, so this recorded result, the numeric report, and the HR-diagram figure cannot silently drift apart. mass_source: AlphaCenAB_orbit.json component_masses_Msun (Akeson et al. 2021 Table 8) primary: requested M=1.079 Msun -> nearest track M=1.1 Msun (1.97% off); independent best-fit age=1.981e+09 yr (1.98 Gyr), chi2=3.228, state=dwarf/main-sequence (log g >= 4.0). FLAG (primary): best-fit age point falls in a sparsely-sampled part of this track's age grid (local spacing 40% of the age there, > 20% threshold) -- the age is only as well-constrained as this spacing allows, independent of the fit's chi2 secondary: requested M=0.9092 Msun -> nearest track M=0.9 Msun (1.01% off); independent best-fit age=2.080e+09 yr (2.08 Gyr), chi2=0.590, state=dwarf/main-sequence (log g >= 4.0). FLAG (secondary): best-fit age point falls in a sparsely-sampled part of this track's age grid (local spacing 98% of the age there, > 20% threshold) -- the age is only as well-constrained as this spacing allows, independent of the fit's chi2 independent-fit age_difference: 9.840e+07 yr (0.10 Gyr) (4.7% of the older independent age). common-age (joint) fit: age=2.080e+09 yr (2.08 Gyr), chi2=3.766, primary log g=4.397 (dwarf/main-sequence (log g >= 4.0)), secondary log g=4.562 (dwarf/main-sequence (log g >= 4.0)). No independent literature age/mass/evolutionary-stage values are recorded for this system, so no discrepancy comparison is made. (No comparison against the source paper's own stated age, if any, is performed.)

data_provenance: REAL measurements (0.2.0): Johnson UBV of alpha Cen A (V 0.00, B-V 0.69, U-B 0.23) and B (V 1.35, B-V 0.90, U-B 0.63) from VizieR II/168/ubvmeans (two observations, one publication, no errors), combined into total-light magnitudes and B - A magnitude differences. Uncertainties: 0.020 (B-V) and 0.028 (U-B) mag, the typical single-value uncertainties of Maiz Apellaniz (2006) Tables 9-10, and an assumed 0.02 mag in V; correlations between the combined magnitudes and the differences are ignored. Distance = 1/pi_orb from PySeshat's own orbit fit of the Akeson et al. (2021) data (dataset weighting; scripts/build_real_sed_benchmarks.py). Replaces the synthetic photometry used before 0.2.0.

distance_pc.source: orbital parallax of PySeshat's real-data orbit fit

metallicity.source: nearest CK04 grid point (ckp02) to [Fe/H] ~ +0.23 (Morel 2018, A&A 615, A172, Sect. 5.1: 'a robust value, [Fe/H] ~ +0.23 dex')
